Projects.title: Projects
Projects.body: Your projects with phases, dates and budget. On the left the filterable list, nested with subprojects; on the right the selected project with status, client, dates and the budget-versus-actual comparison fed from real postings. Phases are ticked off directly in the table. Only a draft can be deleted; everything else keeps its history.
